skill.displayName: A股涨停板龙虎榜深度研判+财富密码策略

llm.summary: The skill appears to be a real finance-report generator, but unsafe report rendering and stale hardcoded output make it a Review case before installation.

dimensions.detail: Report data is interpolated into HTML without escaping and then opened in Chromium with --allow-file-access-from-files, which is broader local-file authority than needed for ordinary report rendering.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Installation is disclosed as manual copying into OpenClaw and MiMo skill directories; no hidden installer was found. Dependencies are documented but unpinned, including Playwright/Chromium.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The trigger phrases are fairly broad for a skill that runs scripts and writes report files, and the runtime instructions do not clearly require user confirmation before file generation and PDF rendering.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill mentions a durable cron schedule for daily generation, but says the repository does not include cron and leaves scheduling to the integrator; this should be an explicit user opt-in.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The finance-report purpose is coherent, but the artifacts overstate the delivered behavior: the skill promises a current HTML/PDF/PPTX three-piece report with broad 21-chapter coverage, while generate_daily.py builds a much smaller HTML/PDF report and the PPTX path still uses hardcoded 2026-09-11 sample content.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you trust the publisher and run it in an isolated project or virtual environment. Do not feed untrusted JSON or upstream market snapshots into the renderer until HTML escaping, a restrictive browser configuration, and dependency pinning are added. Treat generated PPTX files as sample/stale unless you verify the date and data manually.
llm.findings:
[T09] unexpected: Accepted as material: generate_daily.py inserts data-derived strings into HTML without contextual escaping and renders the file with Chromium local-file access enabled.
[TP4] unexpected: Partially accepted: the package contains working strategy/report code, but there is a real mismatch between the advertised data-driven report set and the hardcoded PPTX/sample-date implementation.
[SDI-1] unexpected: Accepted: make_pptx.py still embeds 2026-09-11 values, so generated PPTX output can diverge from the requested date and data.
[E2] expected: Downgraded: os.environ.copy() is used for a local helper subprocess, not shown exfiltrating data, but passing the full environment is unnecessarily broad.
[AE1] expected: Downgraded: assets/echarts.min.js is present as a large local ECharts bundle for chart rendering; no separate hidden fetch or execution path was found.
[RA2] expected: Downgraded: copying files into skill directories is a normal install step, and cron is described as optional integrator configuration rather than installed by the package.
[SQP-1] unexpected: Accepted as a scoping concern: broad finance triggers can invoke a script-writing workflow when the user may only intend analysis.
[AE4] expected: Downgraded: the mixed Chinese/English text matches the skill's domain and did not reveal credential or secret content.
[LP3] unexpected: Accepted as a review concern: the skill documents shell execution and file writes without a clear least-privilege tool or directory scope.
[T08] expected: Accepted as a supply-chain note, not malicious evidence: third-party Python packages and browser artifacts are expected for this workflow but should be version and hash pinned.
